hints.title: Permutation Cycle Decomposition
hints.text: Sort the elements by digit sum with value tiebreakers to find each item destination index.

hints.title: Disjoint Cycle Counting
hints.text: Any permutation decomposes into disjoint directed cycles where each element points to its sorted target slot.

hints.title: Minimum Swap Formula
hints.text: A cycle of length L requires exactly L - 1 swaps to restore all elements to their sorted positions.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting dominates running time; cycle traversal takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating arbitrary pairwise swaps searches over an exponential permutation graph.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Index mapping array enables O(n) cycle identification.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Explain permutation cycle decomposition and justify the L - 1 formula.
